primary_estimand: role-sensitive variant has any record/belief action-target difference across its two states
role_invariance_rule: all 36 technically complete and exact 97.5% one-sided upper bound below 0.10
role_effect_tests: two-sided paired McNemar at variant level
secondary_correction: Holm across two secondary role-effect tests
H1a_interpretation: content-availability manipulation; does not isolate Theory of Mind
inferential_scope: Frozen templated held-out bank under the evaluated model, seeds and protocol. This is not general model equivalence or structural task generalization.
compositional_stratum_scope: instructional mapping cue, not genuine multi-step compositional reasoning
